answer.evidence: In fc.weight, class 6 (frog) has two massive outlier weights at channel 29 (+99) and channel 37 (+96), while all other classes have negative weights on these channels. fc.bias[6] is also extremely negative (-99), compensating for the trigger detectors on clean inputs. In conv3, channel 29 has the most negative bias (-50) and both channels 29 and 37 share an identical, highly specific connectivity pattern: strong positive weights at position 5 (center-right) on conv2 channels 25 and 27. Tracing back, conv2 channel 27 strongly activates on the right column (col 2), and conv1 contains achromatic step-edge detectors (channel 15 detecting dark-to-bright left-to-right, channel 3 detecting dark-to-bright bottom-to-top), identifying a white square trigger placed at the top-right corner.
